executive_summary: Build failed with 43 compilation errors due to missing Maven dependencies. Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Jakarta Persistence, and Apache Commons Lang3 packages are not found. All dependencies must be added to pom.xml to resolve compilation failures.

errors.root_cause: Spring Security dependency is missing from pom.xml. Multiple security-related packages cannot be resolved.
Spring Data JPA dependency is missing from pom.xml. JpaRepository and related annotations cannot be resolved.
Jakarta Persistence API is missing. Entity annotations (@Entity, @Table, @Id, @Column) cannot be resolved.
errors.fix_recommendation: Jakarta Persistence is typically included with spring-boot-starter-data-jpa. Ensure spring-boot-starter-data-jpa dependency is added to pom.xml.

errors.root_cause: Apache Commons Lang3 library is missing from pom.xml.
Spring Data Commons (Pageable, Page) classes are missing. This is part of Spring Data JPA.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add spring-boot-starter-data-jpa dependency to pom.xml if not already present. This includes Spring Data Commons.
